# Review — PAN-5335
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI `lint-group (core)` is red at this HEAD: `lint:harness-branches` rejects the new harness-name branch in `newConversationSummary.ts`

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5335-review-43658f67
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5335/.pan/review/agent-pan-5335-review-43658f67/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5335 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5335
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5384
- HEAD reviewed: 43658f675cd6d45596760aba757b2eea1548f969
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base 8a91697e626f4ea0a82551fcfd51f5f93e943342; no prior review cycle
- Requirements source: `.pan/drafts/pan-5335.md` (the manifest's `acceptanceCriteria` list was empty, so ACs were taken from PRD §7)

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements/validation] New harness-name branch fails the `lint:harness-branches` ratchet, so CI `lint-group (core)` is red — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/frame/newConversationSummary.ts:39`
- Severity: `!` (a mandatory CI quality gate fails on the PR head)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect, in_pr_scope. The PRD D-7 rule ("harness label only when the harness is not `claude-code`") is fine; the way it was written is not. The PRD did not restate the PAN-4562 harness-branch ratchet, so this is also a small spec gap (§5 "Repo rules that apply" should have listed it).
- Trigger and changed-code connection: line 39 is `const harnessLabel = harness !== 'claude-code' ? shortHarness(harness) : null;`. `scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh` counts every `harness ===/!== '<name>'` comparison per file and fails a file that has a match but no row in `scripts/harness-branches-baseline.txt`. `newConversationSummary.ts` is a new file with no row.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected all CI lint lanes green. Observed on the PR head (run 43746804594, job 132911795492): `✖ src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/frame/newConversationSummary.ts: NEW file with 1 harness-name branches` → `Process completed with exit code 1`. The PR cannot merge while this lane is red.
- Evidence: CI job log fetched with `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/actions/jobs/132911795492/logs`; every earlier step in that lane (eslint, lint:effect, lint:permissions, boundaries, liveness, effort, harness-storage) passed. The local verification gate (`overdeck/test`) only ran install + typecheck, so it did not catch this.
- Fix: do not add a baseline row (agents must not raise the ratchet). Route the comparison through the one existing branch in `components/CommandDeck/conversationMeta.ts` (baseline row `1`): add an exported helper such as `nonDefaultHarnessLabel(harness)` there, make `conversationMetaParts` use it instead of its own `harness !== 'claude-code'` check (so the file stays at 1 match), and call the helper from `newConversationSummary.ts`. Then run `bash scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh` locally before pushing.
- Note: while this review ran, the work agent committed and pushed exactly this fix as `4d3ea660d01` ("fix(command-deck): replace the new-conversation harness branch with a shared helper"; `origin/feature/pan-5335` = `4d3ea660d01583d14cae985d8e5f9e7e9d2df9ef`). It adds `nonDefaultHarnessLabel` to `conversationMeta.ts`, routes `conversationMetaParts` through it (file stays at 1 match), and calls it from `newConversationSummary.ts`. On that tree `bash scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh` passes ("201 in 75 files; none new"). It is outside this run's reviewed HEAD; the next cycle must confirm CI `lint-group (core)` is green on `4d3ea660`.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. `~` **`readLastProjectKey()` runs on every App render** — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/App.tsx:184-188`. `initialProjectSelection` is computed in the component body, not inside the `useState`/`useRef` initializers, so every render of the root `App` does a synchronous `localStorage.getItem`. Only the first result is used. The cost is small (an in-memory read), but it is wasted work on the hottest component. Fix: compute it once, e.g. `const [initialProjectSelection] = useState(() => initialProjectKey({...}))`, or a lazily-initialized ref.
2. `?` **Validation checks the current selection, not the stored value** — `App.tsx:728-735`. D-5 says to validate "only a value that came from storage". The effect validates `selectedProjectKey` at the moment `registered-projects` succeeds. If the operator picks a different project before the query resolves, that pick is validated instead. Switcher rows come from known projects, so a false clear is unlikely; it would need a selectable project name that is absent from `/api/registered-projects`. Hardening: capture the storage-derived key in the ref and validate only while `selectedProjectKey` still equals it.
3. `?` **If `/api/registered-projects` errors, the stored project is never validated** — the ref stays `true` until some later success. A dead stored project then stays selected; the deck's `UnknownProjectState` covers the visible case, so this is low impact.
4. Pre-existing / advisory: the collapsed-group filter renders a selected depth-2 descendant without its depth-1 parent row. That matches D-1a ("that one, and only that one") and is not a defect.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger

### Four dimensions
- **Correctness:** traced as above; no logic defects beyond the advisories. Non-goals respected: no server/contract change, popstate handler unchanged, awarenessScope not rewritten, route projects not validated, no file-size allowlist row raised, button color unchanged.
- **Security:** no trust boundary touched. `localStorage` value is only compared and used as a selection key (rendered as React text), no injection path. Inline `backgroundColor` comes from a fixed palette.
- **Performance:** one extra catalog load from `useAvailableModels()` via the shared module-level promise (PRD D-7 accepts this). Finding 1 is a minor per-render storage read. No unbounded work.
- **Requirements/UX:** see matrix below.

### AC-to-evidence matrix
| AC | Status | Evidence |

| AC-9 (WI-8 model line) | met in tests, **unmet at gate level** | tests pass, but `newConversationSummary.ts` fails `lint:harness-branches` (blocking finding) |
| AC-10 (WI-9 marks) | met | `ProjectMark.test.tsx` and `ProjectSwitcher.test.tsx` pass |
| AC-7 (WI-7 docs) | met (content); `lint:docs` unverified locally | docs/changelog content checked by reading; docs lint is in CI lanes |
| AC-8 (live, epic owner) | unverified | live check on :3011 is owned by the epic owner, out of review scope |

## Verification
- CI on PR head 43658f67 (`gh pr checks feature/pan-5335`): `lint-group (core)` **fail** (harness-branches ratchet, see blocker); `build (22)`, `lint-group (state)`, `lint-group (skills)`, clean install + smoke, integrations, prompt trailer gate, mobile-android **pass**; `test-shard 1–4`, `test-e2e`, `lint-group (effect)`, `bare-host-linux` **pending** at review time (unverified, not green). `overdeck/test` (local gate: install + typecheck) passed.
- Focused tests, run once from `src/dashboard/frontend`: `npx vitest run` on the 11 touched test files → 11 files, 213 tests passed. Limitation: the source tree at run time equalled `4d3ea660` (HEAD + the then-uncommitted helper refactor), not byte-exact `43658f67`. The refactor only moves the `harness !== 'claude-code'` check into a shared helper with the same result.
- Test diffs read, not only names: the three WI-1 tests (`renders one toggle and three nested lanes…`, `collapses a group with a working successor by default`, `still renders when localStorage throws`) were updated in place to the collapsed-default expectations, and the two new WI-1 cases exist. No tests were deleted.
- Consumer sweep: grep of `src/dashboard/frontend/src` and `tests/` for `sidebar-command-deck`, `New conversation (N)`, `toHaveTextContent('Machines')`, `Activity Feed`, `MORE_GROUPS` found no untouched consumer tests that depend on the removed behavior. `MORE_GROUPS` has one consumer (`LeftNav.tsx`). The `bg-foreground text-background` hit in `MachineRoomTopbar.tsx` is unrelated.
- Other `isGroupCollapsed` consumers (`ConversationList.tsx` lines 546, 814): the toggle handler and the `collapsed` prop only. No keyboard-order or range-select code derives visible rows from it.
- Command Deck reachability with no project: `G C` shortcut (`App/hooks/useAppShortcuts.ts:24`, `app.lens-command-deck`; covered by the passing `App.test.tsx` "navigates to Command Deck with g c") and the palette's Open Terminal entry (`CommandPalette.tsx:551`) still navigate to `command-deck`.
- Core lint steps that CI never reached (run on the `4d3ea660` tree): `lint:harness-branches`, `workspace-doors`, `park-exits`, `agent-dir-removal`, `prompts`, `prompt-trailer`, `file-size` (NFR-1), `source-introspection`, `no-coderabbit-merge-gate`, `circular`, `ratchet-audit`, `quarantine-audit`, `effect-facades`, `docs` (AC-7), `last-verified`, `upstream-ports` all **pass**. `lint:slash-commands` is **unverified** (needs `dist/cli/index.js` from a CLI build; CI builds first).
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: **unverified**. Not run locally; CI `lint-group (effect)` was pending at review time.
- Full test suite: not run (CI owns it). At signal time the CI run for `4d3ea660` had just started; no test shard results exist for either head.

## Scope Note
The blocker's fix landed on the branch during this review as `4d3ea660d01`, which is pushed. The next cycle only needs to review that 2-file commit and confirm the CI run on `4d3ea660` is green, including `lint-group (core)`, `lint-group (effect)` and the four test shards. Every other finding in this report is advisory.

# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-5335 (PR #5384)

but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5384/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5335 -m "CodeRabbit <thread ids>: <what you changed>"`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5384 has already merged when you read this, stop: after the merge Overdeck files a follow-up issue
   for every thread with no reply, no later commit to its file, and no re-review request naming its thread id.
